chunks: And with this chain, from Ibn Faddal, from Hammad, from Ibrahim bin Umar, from Umar bin Hanzala, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Five [signs] before the rising of the Qaim are among the signs: The Cry, the Sufyani, the Submerging in the Baida', the emergence of the Yamani, and the killing of the Pure Soul.

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: The Sufyani, a tyrannical figure who will rise in Syria before the Qaim.
key_terms.الصَّيْحَةُ: The Cry, a celestial voice or sound announcing the beginning of the Major Occultation or the Qaim's era.
key_terms.النَّفْسِ الزَّكِيَّةِ: The Pure Soul, a highly revered figure who will be killed, an event that triggers the Qaim's rise.
key_terms.الْبَيْدَاءِ: The Baida', a desert plain between Mecca and Medina where a major event of earth swallowing will occur.
key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: The Qaim (Riser), a title for Imam al-Mahdi (a.s) referring to his rising from occultation.
key_terms.الْيَمَانِيُّ: The Yamani, a leader who will emerge from Yemen to support the Qaim.

ai.seo_question: What are the five major signs preceding the reappearance of Imam Mahdi (a.s)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* outlines the five definitive major signs preceding the reappearance of Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.), establishing a chronological framework for Shia eschatology. These events—the celestial Cry, Sufyani’s uprising, the earth swallowing in Baida’, the Yamani’s emergence, and the martyrdom of the Pure Soul—serve as critical markers for the transition from the Minor to the Major Occultation’s conclusion.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 427 - It is narrated from Ibn Faddal from Hammad from Ibrahim bin Umar from Umar bin Hanzala from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said: “

Five signs will become visible before the reappearance of the Qaim: Call from the sky, advent of Sufyani, splitting of the earth in the desert, advent of Yamani and killing of Nafse Zakiyyah (the pure soul).”
